description:
The Vestd connector gives your AI direct access to your company's equity management data - shareholders, share classes, option grants (EMI, ESOP, CSOP, unapproved, growth shares), stock transfers, valuations, dividends, directors, and statutory filings (SH01s, confirmation statements, resolutions).

Instead of navigating the Vestd platform, ask your AI to investigate an issuance, trace a grant's acceptance and signing status, check share authorisation headroom across companies, review governance settings, or summarise ownership structure and dilution - all grounded in your live Vestd data.

Built for founders, finance teams, and company secretaries who manage equity on Vestd and want faster, conversational access to the records behind it.

defaultPrompt: Who do I need to talk to to get a resolution passed?
Find the most recent filed accounts and summarise them.
